issues.description: Synchronous readFileSync on every external stack frame can block the reporter loop
issues.detail: getSourceMap is called per stack frame during error reporting and reads the entire source file (and possibly an external .map file) synchronously with no caching. For large bundles or many frames this re-reads the same file repeatedly. Memoize results per file path to avoid repeated disk I/O.

issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) changes semantics when 'from' is a directory or 's' is absolute
issues.detail: The previous resolve(s, from) treated 'from' as a base; switching to resolve(from, '..', s) assumes 'from' is always a file path and goes up one directory. If 'from' is a directory URL or already resolved with trailing slash, sources resolve one level too high. Verify behavior for sourceRoot and directory-style 'from' values.

issues.description: extractSourcemapFromFile silently swallows malformed inline source maps
issues.detail: convert-source-map.fromSource throws on invalid base64/JSON in some cases; there is no try/catch. A single bad sourcemap comment in a node_modules file would surface as an unhandled exception during error reporting, masking the original test failure. Wrap the extraction in try/catch and log at debug level.

issues.description: Returning '{}' as fallback map string is misleading
issues.detail: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns '{}' when the referenced map file is missing. convert-source-map will parse this as an empty object, which may produce a DecodedMap with no mappings rather than signaling absence. Returning null/undefined or skipping would be clearer; current behavior makes the failure mode silent.

issues.description: Importing SourceMap type from 'rollup' for a convert-source-map return value is a mismatched type
issues.detail: The function is annotated as returning rollup's SourceMap, but convertSourceMap.toObject() returns a RawSourceMap shape that may not match rollup's stricter type (e.g., version as literal 3). Use convert-source-map's own types or @jridgewell/trace-mapping's EncodedSourceMap to avoid future type drift.

issues.description: @types/convert-source-map should be a devDependency, not a runtime dependency
issues.detail: Type packages are not needed at runtime. Adding @types/convert-source-map to 'dependencies' rather than 'devDependencies' bloats the installed footprint for every vitest consumer. Move it under devDependencies.

review.summary: The fix correctly applies source maps to external module stack traces using convert-source-map, but introduces synchronous file I/O per stack frame without caching, which can be slow on large stacks. The resolve() argument reorder in source-map.ts subtly changes semantics for directory-style 'from' values and warrants verification. Error handling around malformed source maps is missing, the fallback '{}' map string is misleading, and the rollup SourceMap type annotation does not match convert-source-map's actual return shape. Also, @types/convert-source-map belongs in devDependencies.
